about: Every object the repo keeps, in the column of the stage that makes it; the edges between them. Copied from the admin Objects tab (src/admin/objects.ts: cols, edges). Regenerate: see README.md.

legend.owner: the module that owns the artifact
legend.valid: the rule that makes it valid

d: proposed until a person approves or rejects
boxes.writer: the discovery agent (discover.md): new files only
boxes.valid: validateProposal: a question no story or earlier proposal asks; status moves only by topics approve|reject (a person) or park (code)

d: judges fit and feasibility; parks the weak
boxes.writer: the review agent (proposal-review.md), never the proposer
boxes.valid: validateReview: one review per proposal; the batch parks on fit false or under topics.minOverall

d: pb-<id> in each listed proposal: one mail
a week; APPROVE <slug> or REJECT by reply
boxes.writer: npm run topics -- batch (code); sent records the Message-ID
boxes.valid: a pb- id signed with APPROVAL_SECRET, listed per institution; a reply applies once per batch and slug

d: their usage and cost, the batch, the mail
boxes.writer: the discovery job (npm run run -- discover)
boxes.valid: one record per weekly slot, written before any agent runs; a crash never doubles the batch or its mail

d: channel and the topics it publishes
boxes.writer: a person (topics claim adds the topic line)
boxes.valid: only channels a person created; a topic is claimed by one commission; the fixture topic is fixtureTopics

boxes.writer: npm run record, record-sources, the watcher CLI
boxes.valid: the store is the only truth of claims and verdicts; a hand edit is reverted by the tree guard

d: a video, post or study: store/videos/*.json
boxes.writer: the watcher (fetch), evidence -- fetch-doc (a study)
boxes.valid: a document saved only under sources/, https, a bare .txt name; a cite names a passage of it

d: shared by every source that makes it
boxes.writer: npm run record from an extraction batch (h*.json)
boxes.valid: one line, no numbers of one source; evidence belongs to the claim, so a new source never re-judges old claims

boxes.writer: npm run record-sources from a study batch (sv_*.json)
boxes.valid: one per claim and document; a study overrides an AI guess only when at least as confident; a cited pair is replaced only with --replace-cited by a person

boxes.writer: npm run report
boxes.valid: derived from the store; the build and the board read it; a stale one is regenerated, never edited

boxes.writer: npm run report (exhibits, revisions), article -- correct (an article revision); the note is a person’s (report -- note)
boxes.valid: exhibits never renumber; every revision needs a note or the build test fails

d: a cite per point; shown on /data/
boxes.writer: a person or an agent, through the data brief
boxes.valid: every point cites a passage; a tool’s defaults cite a dataset

d: groups, fetched lists, study and review rounds
boxes.writer: the topic runner (npm run run -- topic)
boxes.valid: a resumed run never records a batch twice; two empty study rounds park the topic as thin

d: maintenance.json: each scan, what it found
and recorded; due every everyDays days
boxes.writer: npm run evidence -- scanned (from the scan job)
boxes.valid: one entry per scan with found and recorded counts; lastScan decides when the next is due

d: claims that answer it, audit, readiness
boxes.writer: npm run stories -- discover
boxes.valid: derived, never hand-edited; references only, no passage text; the evidence gate decides readiness and fails closed

boxes.writer: the stories.md agent, or a person
boxes.valid: keyed by stable ids; names a current candidate; applicability may narrow, never widen; a chain never nests

boxes.writer: a person
boxes.valid: queued and parked only; the one hand-written planning input

d: passages and roles a writer may use
boxes.writer: npm run script -- package
boxes.valid: built from stories.json and the store; its fingerprint binds the script; a moved package re-opens the review

boxes.writer: a writer agent (script.md); a different reviewer (script-review.md); validate and lock are the CLI’s
boxes.valid: every factual sentence carries an assertion; approvals by fingerprint; three revisions per pass; lock needs passed, storyboard ok, a real approver

boxes.writer: the storyboard.md agent; npm run script -- storyboard fills and checks it
boxes.valid: no narration of its own; chart data is numeric points with a unit and a cite; assets registered by id

d: article-release.json is what the site shows
boxes.writer: a writer agent (article.md); a different reviewer (article-review.md); lock, correct and reaffirm are the CLI’s
boxes.valid: the script’s checks over its sentences plus coverage and overlap; only the release snapshot is rendered

d: text’s fingerprint; OK by reply releases it
boxes.writer: npm run article -- request-correction (the pass), sent (the Message-ID), decide (a person)
boxes.valid: bound to article.json’s fingerprint; a revision voids it; a correction is released only under a person’s name and appends a public-record revision

d: cta.json from cta.md: destinations in the
content graph; a paid one needs your name
boxes.writer: an agent (cta.md); links -- cta approve records a person’s approval of a paid link
boxes.valid: a destination whose value check fails is dropped; a commercial one needs a disclosure and a person’s approvedBy and is never primary

boxes.writer: npm run video -- init from the storyboard; a graphics agent registers bespoke kinds
boxes.valid: every scene names a kind the registry accepts; a cue names a spoken word; an unsupported scene fails the build

d: segment.mp4 named by its sha; build-report;
boxes.writer: npm run video -- spike (draft, edge voice) and final (release, Azure voice); package writes review/
boxes.valid: QA RESULT: PASSED; the package refuses an mp4 whose sha QA did not check; a clearance is recorded, never implied

boxes.writer: npm run music -- cues; import keeps licence.cleared, intensity and loop
boxes.valid: cues over scene anchors, never seconds; the mix keeps the peak under the ceiling by turning the music down, never the narration

boxes.writer: npm run shorts -- discover; the shorts.md agent reviews; the same CLIs produce it
boxes.valid: shorts.json derived; at most 3 per video; its package is a filter of the parent’s; never touches the store

d: routed to the writer or to video-fix, once
boxes.writer: the runner (npm run run -- story), from a request’s notes or --notes-file
boxes.valid: once per request: a sentence or unplaced note to script -- send-back and the writer, a scene-only note to video-fix.md and video -- check

d: publish.json: per output an event log
boxes.writer: npm run publish (every verb idempotent); metadata may be hand-edited
boxes.valid: append-only events; a public upload needs a prior approved for that build; only a person approves or goes live

d: go-live; a Short is output short:<slug>
boxes.writer: npm run publish -- upload, push, go-live, sync, verify (plain fetch, no googleapis)
boxes.valid: upload sends private only; go-live needs approved; a Short goes live after its video; a live video is never replaced

d: calls to action and X text one sha binds
boxes.writer: npm run video -- package (a release build); packaging -- manifest rewrites it
boxes.valid: releaseSha moves when an output is re-packaged, the article re-locked or a call to action changed, and voids the open request

d: decided by OK, OK at <when>, CHANGES: or the page
boxes.writer: npm run publish -- request (automation), decide (a person, never automated:)
boxes.valid: an rq- id signed with APPROVAL_SECRET; expired, decided or moved requests are refused; every step idempotent, decided last

boxes.writer: the release loop (draft-review.md agent)
boxes.valid: no effect on any decision; the digest reads the agreement with the person and says whether agent may be enabled

d: validate, commit, push, probes, liveAt, posted
boxes.writer: the launch job (npm run run -- launch) and the tick’s probe
boxes.valid: resumable step by step; live only once the deploy probe answers; the X post after that, or not-configured

d: social.json: an intent before the call, the
id after; once per text, never a fixture
boxes.writer: npm run social -- post (the launch probe when enabled.social)
boxes.valid: refused while enabled.social is off or the output is not live; not configured without a handle and keys; one post per textSha

d: run/journal.jsonl: one line per step attempt;
halt.json: kind, why, unblock; lock.json: pid
boxes.writer: the runners (story, topic, scan, article pass)
boxes.valid: operational, gitignored, decides no stage; a halt names a command or a brief; a dead lock is taken over

d: call: models, tokens, cost, turns, exit
boxes.writer: the step (steps.ts), open at spawn, complete at exit
boxes.valid: usage and outcome only, never the prompt or the reply; failed and resumed kept; the unit every rollup and estimate sums

d: readiness.json: a person’s verification of an
integration, bound to evidence that exists
boxes.writer: npm run run -- verified (a person; the only writer)
boxes.valid: verification only; implemented is code, enabled is automation.json; a verification changes no flag

d: before the send; a question waits there
boxes.writer: npm run mail -- send | ask | report | questions (orchestration through the Mailer seam, or a session)
boxes.valid: to the configured person only; a question’s status is derived (unsent, failed, awaiting, unattended, answered, closed); a timeout stops the waiter, never the question; an answer is never an authorisation

d: once, with the sent mail it answers
boxes.writer: npm run mail -- fetch (the only IMAP reader; ask runs it while waiting)
boxes.valid: deduplicated by Message-ID; the sender must be the person; a bounce or an ambiguous reply matches nothing and is listed

d: automation.json: a closed key set, every
feature off by default; agent rules are code
boxes.writer: a person
boxes.valid: validated at build; agent permissions are never configuration (roles.ts); secrets stay in .env
